title: image-signing-and-gitops-rotation-playbook
content:
Purpose:
Enable secure, auditable, and automatable CI/CD for private (VPC / on-prem) Redwood deployments with a focus on: image signing, digest-pinned GitOps updates, terraform modules for registry/mirror configuration, and a robust upgrade/rollback playbook for Helm + Argo. This is a working playbook (draft) to be validated by SRE, Security, and Solutions Eng.

Scope & assumptions:
- Applies to private deployments that run a local or customer-managed OCI registry (Harbor/Quay/GCR mirror).
- Customers may be online or air-gapped. The plan supports both modes with conditional steps.
- We assume CI has access to a signing key stored in customer KMS or CI-specific KMS (HSM optional).
- ArgoCD (app-of-apps) is the primary GitOps operator; Argo Rollouts optional for canaries.
- Helm charts are the package format in k8s manifests; chart artifacts may be stored in helm repo or as OCI artifacts.

Goals:
1) All container images deployed by GitOps are signed and have attestations (SBOM + CI provenance).
2) Git commits for manifests contain fully-resolved image digests (sha256) — no mutable tags in production branches.
3) Rolling upgrades supported with automated canary windows, health checks, and deterministic rollback on failure.
4) Terraform modules provide reusable primitives for registry mirroring, kms integration, and Argo bootstrap.

High-level workflow (recommended):
1) Developer triggers CI pipeline (build -> test -> package).
2) CI builds image, creates SBOM, runs security/QA checks.
3) CI signs image with cosign (or equivalent) using a KMS-backed key. Create attestation (in-toto/slsa style).
4) CI pushes image to customer registry and records digest.
5) CI creates/updates a Git commit in the GitOps repository with image digest references (automated PR).
6) ArgoCD detects change, performs sync according to sync waves/canary config. Health checks and admission policies validate signed images.
7) Monitoring/telemetry validates quality; automated rollback if SLOs/health fail.

Concrete CI steps (example using GitHub Actions + cosign):
- Build: docker build -t registry.example.com/team/service:ci-1234 .
- SBOM: syft packages -o cyclonedx=sbom.xml registry.example.com/team/service:ci-1234
- Push: docker push registry.example.com/team/service:ci-1234
- Sign: COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign sign --key kms://projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/signingKey registry.example.com/team/service:ci-1234
- Get digest: digest=$(skopeo inspect --raw docker://registry.example.com/team/service:ci-1234 | sha256sum) or use 'docker inspect --format='{{index .RepoDigests 0}}' ...'
- Update manifests: sed -i 's|image: .*:.*|image: registry.example.com/team/service@sha256:$digest|' k8s/overlays/prod/service-deployment.yaml
- Create PR and merge to gitops/prod branch.

Terraform modules notes (reusable primitives):
- module.registry-mirror:
  - Inputs: origin_registry, mirror_registry, mirror_creds_secret, mirror_bandwidth_limits, mirror_mode (push/pull).
  - Outputs: mirror_registry_url, mirror_service_account, firewall_rules.
  - Purpose: For air-gapped/offline, seed mirror with ORAS artifacts; for VPC, create private GCR/Artifactory with IAM.

- module.kms-key:
  - Inputs: key_purpose (signing/enc), rotation_period_days, principal_bindings.
  - Outputs: key_id, public_key_pem.
  - Notes: Expose a cosign KMS URL format and document CI permission scope.

- module/argo-bootstrap:
  - Tasks: install argocd, create app-of-apps pattern, initial repo credentials (read-only deploy keys), optional SSO/OIDC config.
  - Idempotency: support re-run after partial failure.

Helm & chart strategy:
- Charts: Keep chart semver separate from app version. Patch-level chart changes allowed for patch app upgrades.
- Values schema: provide explict canary boolean, trafficWeight, and rollout duration.
- Chart packaging: publish to internal chartmuseum or push as OCI. For air-gapped: provide .tgz stored in mirror.
- Use immutable values for production (no image tags). Enforce digest usage via pre-commit hooks.

GitOps layout recommendations (repo-level):
- repo-gitops/root (app-of-apps) -> points to env overlays\- repo-gitops/envs/prod/team/service -> kustomize/helm value files with image digests\- CI writes to repo-gitops/auto-updates/* (automated PRs against env branches).

Argo sync & sync-waves:
- Use sync-waves to ensure infra plugins and CRDs apply before workloads.
- Set automated pruning and self-heal with conservative sync options for prod.
- Leverage Argo's resource hooks for pre-sync (smoke tests) and post-sync (integration checks).

Image signing & verification details:
- Signing tool: cosign recommended (OCI-native, supports KMS). Alternative: Notary v2 or Sigstore stack.
- Keys: prefer customer-managed KMS keys. Keep offline revocation steps documented if HSM used.
- Attestations: Store SBOM + pipeline provenance as OCI attestations; index in registry for audit.
- Verification: Admission controller (cosign webhook) validates signature and attestations before allowing pod creation. For extra policy, use Gatekeeper/OPA with Rego referencing signature metadata.

Key rotation flow (short):
- Create new key in KMS, publish public key to verification store (k8s secret/configmap or central verifier).
- Update CI to sign with new key (can be staged by signing both old+new during overlap window).
- Run registry re-sign for live images if policy requires re-signing with new key (non-trivial for immutable registries; prefer verifying existing signature chain).
- Revoke old key only after verification that all running attestations accept new key or after TTL.

Air-gapped / offline special considerations:
- Provide artifact bundles: ORAS tarball (images + attestations) + helm charts tar.
- Terraform module should support a 'seed' job to import the tarball into the local registry. Document checksums and SBOM verification post-seed.
- CI in offline environments will often be an internal runner; ensure cosign can access KMS or use offline signing workflows (protected signing host with exported key material if permitted).

Canary & rollback strategy:
- Canary via Helm values (replica fraction, trafficWeight) + Argo Rollouts for progressive traffic shifting.
- Health checks: readinessProbe, canary-promQL queries (latency/error thresholds).
- Automatic rollback: Argo Rollouts with analysis templates. Fallback: ArgoCD rollback to previous commit (git revert automated).

Admission & policy enforcement checklist:
- Verify image signature and attestation exists for each container image.
- Enforce image digest pins in manifests on merge via CI pre-merge checks.
- OPA/Gatekeeper policy to deny unsigned images or images not in allowlist.
- Network policy to restrict registry egress for non-prod clusters.

Runbook: upgrade (summary):
1) Green branch: verify CI pipeline green and image signed.
2) Merge auto-update PR to gitops/prod.
3) Argo sync starts; monitor pre-sync hooks.
4) During canary window watch metrics (error rate, p95 latency, restart count).
5) If pass, allow full rollout; if fail, trigger rollback via Argo Rollouts or revert commit and let ArgoCD reconcile.

Emergency rollback (manual):
- kubectl -n <ns> rollout undo deployment/<svc> --to-revision=<rev> (if using native rollout).
- Or revert git commit that introduced digest change and force Argo sync.
- If admission controller blocks older unsigned image, temporarily allowlist the old digest in policy store and re-sync.

Testing & validation matrix (must-have tests):
- CI signs image and verification step using a staging admission controller.
- Terraform infra module tests: unit tests for module inputs, integration test that provisions a mirror stub.
- Argo e2e: staged sync with app-of-apps, simulated network partition, and recovery.
- Air-gapped seed test: import tarball, verify SBOM and cosign attestations.

Operational TODOs / open questions (work items):
- [ ] Decide authoritative attestation format (in-toto vs custom).
- [ ] Add terraform automation for cosign public key distribution to clusters during bootstrap.
- [ ] Document operator for automated key rotation with minimal availability impact.
- [ ] Finalize Gatekeeper policies for image allowlist lifecycle.
- [ ] Implement CI job to automatically re-sign critical base images on key rotation if customer policy requires.

Appendix: useful commands and links
- cosign verify --key k8s://secret/cosign-public registry.example.com/team/service@sha256:<digest>
- oras push --manifest-config config.json registry.example.com/team/service:ci-1234 
- skopeo inspect --raw docker://registry.example.com/team/service:ci-1234

End of draft.
